subject: Direct link to SALCI + a quick install guide
entity_name: Alliance International School portal access update
html_body:

Hi {{name}},

Quick note from us — here's the direct link to the SALCI portal. Bookmark it, and you're set.

We've also recorded a short video that walks you through how to install SALCI as a webapp on your phone, so day-to-day access feels like a native app (works on both Android and iPhone).

Open SALCI Portal
▶ Watch install video

Buttons not working? Copy these links

Portal: https://www.salci.in

Install video: https://drive.google.com/file/d/19F2KBq3WXYevRFToMpoo7TtfcDFQrsNr/view?usp=sharing

If anything's not working for you, just reply to this email — we're here to help.

— SALCI

Sent to staff at Alliance International School on SALCI.
